# Vendored `@cyfers/plugin-types`

**Do not edit these files by hand.**

Source of truth: [`Samhij/cyfer-plugins` → `types/`](https://github.com/Samhij/cyfer-plugins/tree/main/types)

Refresh from a sibling checkout (or `CYFER_PLUGINS_DIR`):

```bash
node scripts/sync-plugin-types.js
```

Without a local clone, the script fetches `types/*` from `cyfer-plugins` `main`.
